name: The Celestial Carousel of Fireflies
description: A carousel driven by swarms of fireflies, each wing of the carousel crafted from polished moonstone, rotating slowly over a meadow of night‑blooming lilies.
prompt: A magical Celestial Carousel of Fireflies: moonstone carousel wings adorned with shimmering constellations, fireflies serving as steeds rotating gracefully, surrounding meadow of luminous night lilies, soft starlight, dreamy atmosphere, fantasy illustration.
caption: Ride the Celestial Carousel of Fireflies—where each spin weaves a galaxy of twinkling dreams ✨🐦.
